name: Video Watermark Remover
description: An intro page for removing watermarks from videos. Its buttons open Video Studio, where you upload the video and remove the watermark.
shortDescription: Intro page that sends you to Video Studio to remove video watermarks.
fullDescription: Video Watermark Remover (#/video-watermark, 'Watermark Remover' in the app menu) is an information page titled 'Video Watermark Remover - Remove watermarks, logos, and unwanted elements from your videos with AI'. It has a 'Remove Watermarks Free' button, a 'Powerful Removal Tools' section (Smart Removal, Precise Editing, Fast Processing, Professional Results), a 'How It Works' section (01 Upload Video, 02 AI Processing, 03 Download), an 'Available Tools' section with three cards (AI Video Watermark Remover, AI Video Object Remover, AI Video Logo Remover) and a closing 'Clean Your Videos Today' box with 'Get Started Free'. Nothing is uploaded or processed on this page: every button and card opens Video Studio (#/video). The removal itself happens there: click the video button left of the prompt (tooltip 'Upload video to remove watermark'), choose a video, and the studio switches to the 'AI Video Watermark Remover' model, greys out the prompt with 'Video ready — click Generate to remove watermark', and Generate makes the clean video. Video Studio also lists 'Seedance 2 Video Watermark Remover Pro'. There is no separate object-remover or logo-remover model behind those two cards; they open Video Studio like the others.
bestFor: Anyone who wants to remove a watermark, logo, caption or overlaid text from a video they have the right to edit.
whenToUse: You want to know how video watermark removal works in the app.
You want a quick way into Video Studio's watermark remover.
whenToUseAnother: Use Video Studio (#/video) directly if you already know the steps.
Use Edit Studio (#/edit) to remove a watermark or object from a still image.
Use Video Tools (#/videotools) for other video clean-up and conversion tools.
keyFeatures: 'Remove Watermarks Free' and 'Get Started Free' buttons open Video Studio
'Powerful Removal Tools' and 'How It Works' overview sections
Available Tools cards: AI Video Watermark Remover, AI Video Object Remover, AI Video Logo Remover
The actual removal in Video Studio: upload a video and Generate with the AI Video Watermark Remover model

The model switches to 'AI Video Watermark Remover', the prompt is disabled with 'Video ready — click Generate to remove watermark', and the button turns green with a tick. Click Generate.

howToUse: 1. Open Video Watermark Remover (#/video-watermark). 2. Click 'Remove Watermarks Free' (or any tool card) to open Video Studio. 3. In Video Studio click the video button left of the prompt ('Upload video to remove watermark') and choose your video. 4. Check the model reads 'AI Video Watermark Remover' and the prompt says 'Video ready — click Generate to remove watermark'. 5. Click Generate and download the result.
howToSteps: In Video Studio, upload your video with the video button.
gettingStarted: Start with a short clip so you can check the result quickly.
Only remove watermarks from videos you own or have permission to edit.

faqs.question: Where do I upload my video?
faqs.answer: Not on this page. Click Remove Watermarks Free to open Video Studio, then use the video button left of the prompt ('Upload video to remove watermark').

faqs.question: Do I need to write a prompt?
faqs.answer: No. After the upload the prompt is disabled and reads 'Video ready — click Generate to remove watermark'.

faqs.question: Can it remove logos and captions too?
faqs.answer: The AI Video Watermark Remover model is described as removing 'watermarks, logos, captions, and unwanted text from videos'.

faqs.question: Is it really free?
faqs.answer: The buttons say 'Free', but the removal runs on your MuAPI key and the upload needs credits. The exact cost is not stated on this page.

glossary.Watermark: A logo or text laid over a video, often to show who owns it.
